title: A quarrel staged for others
odia:
ଅଙ୍ଗୁଳି ସନ୍ଧିରେ ମଳି
ଭିତରେ ଭିତରେ ସଲା ସୁତୁରାଲୋ
ଉପରେ ଉପରେ କଳି ।
literal_meaning: Dirt between the fingers; agreement behind the scenes, quarrelling on the surface.
explanation: Two sides appear to fight while privately cooperating. The repeated contrast between inside and outside exposes a performance meant to mislead an audience. The saying accuses the quarrel of being staged; it does not merely describe people who disagree but remain friendly.
meaning_odia: ବାହାରେ ଝଗଡ଼ାର ଦୃଶ୍ୟ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଭିତରେ ଦୁଇ ପକ୍ଷର ବୁଝାମଣା ରହିଛି। ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଭୁଲ୍ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ବିରୋଧର ଅଭିନୟ କରାଗଲେ ଏହି କଥା ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ସତରେ ମତଭେଦ ହେଉଥିବା ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କୁ ମାତ୍ର ଦେଖି ଏପରି ଗୋପନ ବୁଝାମଣା ଧରିନେବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Two organisers loudly blame each other in public, although they have already agreed privately to divide the benefit. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The three source lines are retained. The address particle ଲୋ adds a conversational voice; the English rendering conveys the contrast without inventing a named listener.

odia_summary: ଭିତରେ ମିଳାମିଶା ରଖି ବାହାରେ ଲୋକଦେଖାଣିଆ କଳି କରିବା।
english_summary: The quarrel is for the audience; the supposed opponents are cooperating in private.

graphic.alt: Two organisers shake hands privately, then stage an argument before an onlooker.
